alerts.headline: Gale Watch issued October 18 at 2:16PM EDT until October 21 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Cape Cod Bay; Nantucket Sound; Vineyard Sound; Buzzards Bay; Rhode Island Sound; Block Island Sound
alerts.description: * WHAT...Northeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas 4 to 7 feet possible. * WHERE...Portions of Massachusetts coastal waters and Rhode Island coastal waters. * WHEN...From Monday evening through Wednesday evening. * IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
alerts.instruction: Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible hazardous conditions. Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
